intro: The spreadsheets must already exist: the app does not create them. Before every write a copy is saved next to the file in the backups folder (kept {{days}} days); restore it on the Advanced tab.

smb.title: Network drive

files.title: Files
files.hint: Paths are locked against accidental edits.

probeSheet.title: Probe sheet
probeSheet.hint: The app reads one year's sheet. By default the current one; while the new year's sheet is still empty, the previous year is read too.
